# Bartosz Osiej

> Polish software developer and author (b. 2007-01-11, Szczecin). Builds Rust, eBPF and Linux kernel systems and writes crime-horror fiction. Entity home.

## Identity
- Name: Bartosz Dominik Osiej
- Roles: Software Developer; Systems Programmer; Author
- Expertise: Rust, eBPF, Linux kernel, security, post-quantum cryptography, compilers
- Languages: Polish (native), English (professional)
